_doc: Arms' one timing table (SPEC §24). Ticks at 20 a second; recovery scales with attack speed. The server's hits, the first- and third-person clips, the trails and the sounds all read these rows. Swing poses place the weapon in first person: the hand's x (right +) and y (up +) in blocks from vanilla's resting hand, the blade's roll in the screen's plane (degrees, + toward the off hand) and optionally the tip's tilt forward (degrees: a chop, a thrust); the hand travels between them on an arc about the shoulder; lunge in blocks. swish: the move's sound through the air, light (the default), heavy, thrust or art. art: an Art's wave (its reach grows wave blocks a tick through the active ticks, out to range). The Art: a heavy held through to full charge with full Resonance. undercut: a strike out of a slide. plunge: a strike in a fall of 2+ blocks, landing all round, harder the further the fall.
